task.title: TestUpdateCanonicalRefsUsesOneCompareAndSwapTransaction flakes with text file busy on Linux
task.description:
Seen on PR #179's Verify on ubuntu-24.04 (run 38253561286, 2026-10-12), in a package that PR did not touch:

    sync_plan_test.go:221: git for-each-ref ... refs/workbook/tasks/ failed: fork/exec /tmp/TestUpdateCanonicalRefsUsesOneCompareAndSwapTransaction.../003/git: text file busy
    --- FAIL: TestUpdateCanonicalRefsUsesOneCompareAndSwapTransaction (0.20s)

internal/gitstore/sync_plan_test.go (~326) writes a fake `git` shell script with os.WriteFile and executes it straight away. On Linux, exec of a file fails with ETXTBSY while any process holds it open for writing; with parallel tests, another goroutine's fork can inherit the still-open write descriptor between WriteFile and exec (golang/go#22315). A rerun passed. Fix it at the root rather than retrying blindly: write the fake executable to a temporary name and rename it into place (or write it in a forked-safe way), and check internal/ and scripts/ tests for other places that write and then exec a helper (grep os.WriteFile with 0o755/0755) and share one helper for it.
